description: This file defines the ProductListActivity, a core UI component of an Android shopping application. It manages displaying a list of products with functionalities for filtering, searching, preset management, and state handling, including loading/error states, using paging, coroutines, and Android UI components.

classes.name: ProductListActivity
classes.description: An Android activity responsible for displaying a list of products, managing search, filters, presets, and UI states.

methods.name: setupPresetsAndClearAll
methods.description: Initializes button listeners for resetting filters and managing presets.

methods.name: setupSearchAndFilters
methods.description: Sets up search input, category spinner, and price filter chips with their event handlers.

methods.name: syncFilterControlsToState
methods.description: Synchronizes UI controls with the current filter and query state, especially when applying presets.

methods.name: renderActiveFilterChips
methods.description: Displays removable chips representing active filters and search queries.

methods.name: showSavePresetDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog for user to input preset name and save the current filter/query as a preset.

methods.name: showPresetsDialog
methods.description: Displays a list of saved presets allowing applying or deleting them.

methods.name: showPresetActionDialog
methods.description: Presents options (apply, delete) for a selected preset.

methods.name: confirmDeletePreset
methods.description: Prompts user for confirmation before deleting a preset.

methods.name: updateEmptyStateText
methods.description: Updates UI text for empty states based on current query and filters.
